# 测试样例：覆盖查看器需要处理的语法情况
# 注释、引号字符串、relative_position_id、互斥、多组前置、嵌套 if/limit

focus_tree = {
	id = test_tree

	country = {
		factor = 0
		modifier = {
			add = 10
			tag = GER
		}
	}

	default = no

	focus = {
		id = T_root
		icon = GFX_goal_generic_political_pressure
		x = 0
		y = 0
		cost = 10
		prerequisite = { }
		completion_reward = { add_political_power = 50 }
	}

	focus = {
		id = T_left
		icon = GFX_focus_generic_military
		x = -1
		y = 1
		cost = 10
		prerequisite = { focus = T_root }
		mutually_exclusive = { focus = T_right }
		available = {
			has_government = fascism   # 行尾注释
		}
		completion_reward = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_idea = test_idea }
				remove_ideas = test_idea
			}
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = T_right
		icon = GFX_focus_generic_military
		x = 1
		y = 1
		prerequisite = { focus = T_root }
		mutually_exclusive = { focus = T_left }
	}

	focus = {
		id = T_rel
		icon = GFX_goal_generic_army
		x = 2
		y = 0
		relative_position_id = T_root
		prerequisite = {
			focus = T_left
			focus = T_right
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = T_or
		x = 0
		y = 2
		prerequisite = { focus = T_left }
		prerequisite = { focus = T_right }
	}
}

focus_tree = {
	id = second_tree

	focus = {
		id = S_only
		icon = GFX_goal_generic_small_arms
		x = 0
		y = 0
	}
}
